title: Eric Davis offers full testimony for blanket immunity

tellings.quote: Eric Davis is actually on record as part of James Fox's last movie saying if you give me blanket immunity, I will say everything I know.

plain: A Pentagon scientist named Eric W. Davis is said to have stated on camera that if he were given blanket immunity, meaning full legal protection from prosecution, he would tell everything he knows. A researcher named Eric Weinstein points to this, saying Davis is "on record" in the most recent film by James Fox. It would suggest Davis holds secrets he feels he cannot legally share.
